# theme API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Convert supplied host themes and choose shared Fluent Teams themes.

## createFluent9ThemeFromSPFxTheme

Converts an SPFx v8 theme to a Fluent UI 9 theme.
Preserves the migration shim's token mappings except accessible neutral
stroke hover/pressed colors, which use the host palette's neutralPrimary
and neutralDark. Missing/empty state colors retain the shim's fallback.
Does not mutate the SPFx theme. Undefined retains the shared webLightTheme;
custom palettes remain responsible for usable color/contrast differences.
Requires the installed Fluent theme/migration peers. Supply the result to a
FluentProvider to establish CSS variables; this function mounts no provider.

### Imports

```ts
import { createFluent9ThemeFromSPFxTheme } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { createFluent9ThemeFromSPFxTheme } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/helpers';
```

### Use when

- You have a host theme outside the toolkit hooks and need Fluent UI 9 tokens for a FluentProvider.

### Examples

#### Basic usage

```ts
import type { IReadonlyTheme } from '@microsoft/sp-component-base';
import { createFluent9ThemeFromSPFxTheme } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function convertTheme(spfxTheme: IReadonlyTheme | undefined) {
  return createFluent9ThemeFromSPFxTheme(spfxTheme);
}
```

#### Compose a host theme without mutating shared themes

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import type { IReadonlyTheme } from '@microsoft/sp-component-base';
import { FluentProvider } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { createFluent9ThemeFromSPFxTheme, getTeamsFluentTheme } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function HostTheme({ spfxTheme, children }: { spfxTheme: IReadonlyTheme | undefined; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const theme = createFluent9ThemeFromSPFxTheme(spfxTheme);
  return <FluentProvider theme={theme}>{children}</FluentProvider>;
}
const light = createFluent9ThemeFromSPFxTheme(undefined);
const teamsDark = getTeamsFluentTheme('DARK');
const fallback = getTeamsFluentTheme(undefined);
// Treat these shared returned objects as immutable. Theme hooks own live host subscriptions.
```

### Signatures

```ts
(spfxTheme: IReadonlyTheme | undefined): Theme
```

#### Parameters

- `spfxTheme`: SPFx theme, or undefined for the default web light theme

#### Returns

Fluent UI 9 theme

## getTeamsFluentTheme

Returns a shared Fluent Teams theme after case-insensitive matching. Dark selects teamsDarkTheme; contrast/highcontrast selects teamsHighContrastTheme; default, unknown and undefined select teamsLightTheme. Treat the returned shared theme as immutable.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import { getTeamsFluentTheme } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { getTeamsFluentTheme } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/helpers';
```

### Use when (2)

- You already have the Teams theme name and need the corresponding shared Fluent theme.

### Examples (2)

```ts
import { getTeamsFluentTheme } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

const theme = getTeamsFluentTheme('dark');
```

### Signatures (2)

```ts
(teamsThemeName: string | undefined): Theme
```

#### Parameters (2)

- `teamsThemeName`: Host theme name; surrounding whitespace is not trimmed.

#### Returns (2)

Shared Fluent UI 9 Teams theme.
